title: cpmdc
description: cpmdc is the C ABI layer for embedding OpenCPMD (https://github.com/OpenCPMD/CPMD) in OmniPotentRPC tools. It gives non-Fortran callers one stable boundary for CPMD setup, geometry steps, feature discovery, and result messages.
